description: Division with compile-time zero-divisor elimination using NonZero semantics from std/core.mm. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/safe_div — verified integer division'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_sub, safe_narrow, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: safe_div
atoms.description: Division of two non-negative i64 values where the divisor is statically proven non-zero via the `b != 0` precondition. Z3 integer theory fully verifies the contract.
atoms.ensures: result >= 0 && result <= a && result * b <= a
